outcome: Presence, extent, and severity of intra-abdominal adhesions
cohort: The cohort consisted of 144 women undergoing benign gynaecologic surgery between April 2015 and June 2015.
finding: The visceral slide test demonstrated high diagnostic accuracy for detecting intra-abdominal adhesions, with a sensitivity of 97.2%, specificity of 68.6%, and overall diagnostic accuracy of 90.3%.
